preconditions.description: The number of rows in the pictures is between 3 and 30, inclusive.
The number of columns in the pictures is between 3 and 30, inclusive.
The number of copies made is between 0 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each picture consists of n lines, each consisting of m characters, each character is either 0 or 1.
preconditions.description: Each picture is an n x m matrix with elements 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: The first line of the output contains a single integer representing the index of the initial picture.
postconditions.description: The index of the initial picture is provided in the first line of the output.

postconditions.expression: The second line of the output contains a single integer q representing the number of operations.
postconditions.description: The number of operations is provided in the second line of the output.

postconditions.expression: Each of the next q lines contains an operation.
postconditions.description: The operations are listed in order they were applied, with each operation represented as specified.

postconditions.expression: Each index from 1 to k+1 appears exactly once in the output.
postconditions.description: The index of the initial picture and the indices of the copies appear exactly once in the output.

invariants.expression: The sequence of operations is valid and corresponds to the sequence of operations that produced the given pictures.
invariants.description: The sequence of operations is valid and corresponds to the sequence of operations that produced the given pictures.
